Subject: [MAP Kickoff] Dedicated capacity trial week, throughput SLOs & stakeholder owners

Hi Tom / Priya —

Thanks again for the time last week. As discussed, we’ve put together an initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) focused on the Dedicated capacity evaluation and a short trial week to validate throughput and latency at scale. The goal of this thread is to align owners, acceptance gates, and the close timeline so everyone knows next steps.

High-level proposal (see attached MAP and acceptance criteria CSV):
- Trial window: 2027-11-15 to 2027-11-19 (one full business week)
- Throughput target: 75 sustained RPS (customer-facing inference requests) across the pool
- Latency SLO: p95 generate latency < 120 ms for average prompt mix (50–150 tokens)
- GPU pool target: 8 x A100-equivalent with rolling availability for headroom
- Quality gate: pass regression checks for our customer prompt eval set (>= 95% parity on core prompts)
- Cost/ops gate: unit cost per 1k tokens within agreed threshold (see CSV)

Suggested owners (please confirm or propose alternates):
- Redwood: Vivek (technical lead, infra config), Marissa (throughput runs & evals), Sean (on-call during trial)
- Ava Solutions: Tom (procurement/ops lead), Priya (product side owner)

Immediate asks:
1) Can you confirm the trial window (Nov 15–19) or suggest an alternative?
2) Confirm stakeholders who need access to the trial dashboards and whether we should provision a read-only Grafana link.
3) Any procurement or legal blockers for temporary trial credits? We can offer a short trial credit commitment while the MAP is active.

I’ve attached dedicated_capacity_MAP_v1.xlsx (owners + timeline) and throughput_acceptance_criteria.csv (detailed SLOs & pass/fail thresholds). Proposed kickoff call: Wed, Nov 8 at 10:00 AM PT — please reply with availability.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this started.

—
Soojin Lee
Director, Solutions Engineering | Redwood Inference

Soojin —

Appreciate the clear plan. Nov 15–19 works for us tentatively; I’ll confirm final availability after I sync with our Infra/Platform team on Monday. Two quick items from our side: 

1) Access & observability — we’ll need read-only access to the trial dashboards and a sampling feed (request: anonymized request ids + logs) so our product team can validate behaviour. Is that straightforward to provision for the trial?

2) Billing — how will trial billing be handled? We expect a short-term credit is fine but we need a written note for procurement that the trial is billed at the metered rate with a pre-approved credit cap (we can sign a short addendum).

Also, can we add an "error budget" acceptance gate (e.g., <1% request error rate during trial) to the CSV? If that’s already in the pass/fail list, ignore me.

I’m copying Priya who will coordinate access and procurement on our side.

Thanks — Tom

Adding a couple practical gates we should include in the MAP and who will own them: 

- Quality evals: Marissa to run the prompt eval harness daily during trial, report regressions and a short root-cause note for any >5% variance. (Owner: Marissa)
- Throughput ramp playbook: we need a schedule for traffic ramp (25%/50%/75%/100% over first two days) and a rollback policy at each step. I’ll draft the runbook. (Owner: Vivek)
- Error budget: Agree with Tom — set <1% request error rate for the week, otherwise pause ramp and investigate. (Escalation: Sean on-call)

I’ll update the MAP spreadsheet to include these gates and owners. Also flag: if we require additional GPUs beyond 8 for short bursts, we should confirm burst quota now so procurement isn’t a blocker.

—Vivek
